Running head at top centre, page number top right. Signature and catchword at the foot. No margin notes; show-through marks at the left and right edges are not transcribed.

main_text.p: habitatorum & præsidiariorum in potestatem Saracenorum devenit, totaque fere diruta concidit, atque in solitudinem rediit. Nec postea resurrexit unquàm, fortunaque ejus Tunetem in urbem vicinam migravit, quæ jam amplissimi regni caput, & regum aut proregum sedes est. Clades illa πανώλεθρος à Saracenis ei accidit imperante Romanis Constantino Pogonato, urbis Romæ anno MCCCCXXXVIII, qui concurrit cum æræ Christianæ vulgaris anno DLXXXV, Hegirae Mahometicæ LXV.
main_text.head: II. APPENDIX DE SITV, AMPLITVDINE, Magnificentia, Portu Carthaginis.
main_text.p: Arthaginis situm, amplitudinem, magnificentiam, portum nobilissimum antiquos scriptores optimos velut penicillo delineare, & oculis nostris quasi subjicere, dixi. Eorum verba libet hic in gratiam lectorum asscribere.In parte ea litoralis Africæ, secundum mare medi-

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of the last paragraph hides the first letter; the visible letters read "Arthaginis", so the word is probably "Carthaginis". The Greek word πανώλεθρος and the small-capital numerals (MCCCCXXXVIII, DLXXXV, LXV) are transcribed as printed. "asscribere.In" has no space after the full stop, as printed. Long s is written as plain s in "scriptores" and elsewhere. The faint marks at the far right and left edges, and the small figures at the lower right, are show-through or edge of the neighbouring page and are omitted.
